messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning to enable account-scoped flag `enterprise_sso_ui` for one enterprise account next Tue (narrowcast rollout). Need clarity on contract gating and which IDs to allow.
kevin: +1. Are we gating by contract start date or contract_id? For Acme we need the start-date window applied (their onboarding begins 2026-04-01).
raj: Recommend gating by contract_id for the flag plumbing, and apply the start-date check in the rollout policy. Keeps enforcement separate.
sylvia: FYI security asked that VIP accounts (support SLA tier) also bypass the gradual canary and get fast path. Which list are we using for VIPs?
maria: We'll use `enterprise_meta.vip=true` in tenant metadata. Proposal: rollout policy = {allowlist: [contract_id:ACME-349], vip_bypass: true, canary_pct: 10 -> 50 -> 100, start_date: 2026-04-01}. Pasting sample config:
```
flag: enterprise_sso_ui
scope: account
rollout:
  - phase: canary
    pct: 10
    filters:
      contract_id: ACME-349
      tenant_meta.start_date.gte: 2026-04-01
  - phase: ramp
    pct: 50
    vip_bypass: true
  - phase: full
    pct: 100
```
kevin: One ops question — how do we revoke if admin opts out mid-rollout? Do we keep contract-level override + temp-exclusion list?
raj: We already support a per-account override and an exclusion slice. I suggest we add a short-lived exclusion path: `exclusions: [{account: <id>, until: <ts>}]` so the flag evaluation sees exclusion first.
sylvia: Also add an audit log event for VIP bypass actions — security wants traceability.
flagbot: deploy-bot: Staging: `enterprise_sso_ui` set to "account" scope for contract ACME-349 at 1769991200 by maria. :white_check_mark:
maria: Can someone from infra confirm the rollout policy will route traffic to the dedicated stack for ACME (they're on Dedicated capacity)? @kevin @raj
kevin: Confirmed — routing rule `route_by_customer` will send ACME requests to dedicated-acc-12 when flag active. I'll run a quick smoke test after staging flip.
raj: I can add the exclusion path change and update the eval chain tonight. Will post the PR link.
sylvia: I'll add the audit events and remove admin bypass for non-VIP accounts. Also looping in security for a final review. :eyes:
maria: Thanks — plan: PRs in by EOD, staging smoke test tomorrow, prod rollout starting 2026-04-01 window. If any blocker ping here.
